params.title: 50 W amplifier, CFP output on MJL4281A / MJL4302A
params.creator: A. Dumchin

params.text: +/-30 V, 51 W into 8 ohm at 1 % THD. NPN input pair VT1/VT2 with emitter resistors and an LED-referenced tail sink (VT3); PNP VAS VT4 loaded by the current sink VT10; R10 keeps VT10 from robbing the LED reference when the output clips (no latch-up).
Complementary feedback pair output: BD139/BD140 drivers, MJL4281A/MJL4302A (TO-264) outputs on a 0.6 K/W heatsink, 0.33 ohm emitter resistors. Fuse both rails in the supply.
RP1 on the Vbe multiplier VT9 sets the quiescent current (about 55 mA); mount VT9 on the heatsink. Gain R5/R4 + 1 = 23.5 (27 dB).
